about_item: FLEA, TICK & MOSQUITO PROTECTION FOR DOGS: Vectra 3D provides powerful flea and tick prevention for dogs while also repelling mosquitoes. Each topical application delivers up to one month of protection.

FAST-ACTING TOPICAL FLEA & TICK TREATMENT: This fast‑acting dog flea and tick treatment begins reducing flea feeding in as little as 5 minutes and kills fleas within 4 hours on dogs—no biting required
PROTECTION FOR DOGS WHO DO MORE: Built for dogs with more everyday exposure - from yards and parks to trails, travel and outdoor family adventures.

MONTHLY TOPICAL ROUTINE: This monthly topical flea and tick treatment uses a single‑dose, direct‑to‑skin applicator with a quick‑drying, non‑greasy formula. Waterproof after 24 hours, making it a dependable dog flea treatment for real‑life conditions.
VET RECOMMENDED, NO PRESCRIPTION NEEDED: Used by veterinarians for nearly 20 years and available without a prescription.

authors_reviews.title: You get what you pay for!
authors_reviews.text: This is THE BEST flea, tick, mite, mosquito, parasite killing and repelling product for dogs on the market...hands down. I will never use anything else. It's worth the extra cost, and I never have to worry that my dog will get fleas or ticks. I stopped using it one summer, and there were fleas on her that then were in my house. She never has a negative reaction from the application, and she doesn't mind when I apply it - easy as pie and very "neat" to open the tube and apply. Even though it says it dries quickly, it still looks "wet" for at least a couple of days, so we are careful not to pet her on the application site. We wait at least a day to bathe her for our own comfort about touching and cuddling her. It used to be available only through a vet's office - VERY expensive. Now, Amazon has made it much more affordable and accessible. LOVE AMAZON...LOVE THIS PRODUCT!
authors_reviews.author: OldAngel

authors_reviews.title: BEST ON THE MARKET
authors_reviews.text: I have used Vectra exclusively for several years, and am very happy with the results. No fleas, no ticks and even noproblem with mosquitoes. Vectra does not, This is a huge factor for seizure prone dogs like mine.

authors_reviews.title: DO NOT GIVE YOUR DOG IF THEY HAVE A HISTORY OF SEIZURES
authors_reviews.text: ***DO NOT USE THIS PRODUCT IF YOUR DOG HAS A HISTORY OF SEIZURES!!*** This medication killed my beloved dog, he had a history of seizures for about a year, and our vet told us it was ok because it’s topical, but it’s NOT!!! We chose this one because it doesn’t have the warning, but It’s worse than the pills because once it’s absorbed into the skin there’s literally NOTHING you can do to help. Prior to my dog taking it he would seize and then be ok afterwards but after we gave him this he didn’t stop seizing for 3 days, we admitted him to the ICU and had to put him in a medically induced coma to stop the seizures, and after 3 weeks of treatment (amounting to 30k) we lost him. Please do not believe any of the labels or lack of warnings they put on the labels about it not affecting dogs that have a history or seizures, or any other bullshit they say. These flea “remedies” are terrible please don’t let your dog have the same fate as mine.
